Dear Hiring Committee,

I am writing to express my interest in the Research Associate position (J0526-0155) at the Marelli lab at RI-MUHC. I currently work as a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Centre de recherche du CHUM (CRCHUM) in Montréal. I earned a Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering from the University of Arkansas. During my doctoral and postdoctoral training, I have been able to work with epidemiologists, clinicians, and preclinical researchers in all phases of projects of cancer research, statistical modeling, and clinical research. I firmly believe my research and technical skills are a perfect fit for the advertised position.

My current work involves analyzing large electronic health records: developing reproducible data pipelines, conducting statistical analyses, and data visualization using R in high-performance computing environments. I have ample experience working with large healthcare databases, and the nuances required for their analyses. I am also in charge of manuscript writing, aiming high-impact medical journals. In my previous postdoctoral and doctoral training, my research has covered cancer preclinical research, statistical methods, and public health. 

I am fully proficient in English and French. As I currently work at CRCHUM, I am fluent in written and spoken French, whereas my doctoral training and my current position have helped me develop the required advanced oral and written English skills for scientific writing, grant preparation, and critical review of technical literature. I have 5 first-author peer-reviewed publications in journals such as _One Health_, _Statistics in Medicine_, _Vaccine_ and _Neoplasia_, and I have collaborated to more than 5 peer-reviewed publications as co-author.  I have experience in grant writing, including a successful grant supported by the Canadian Institutes of Health Research.

My work requires collaboration with multidisciplinary teams that include clinicians, statisticians, and public health researchers. I can work independently while maintaining clear communication and consistent project organization. I am detail oriented and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously. I approach research problems with flexibility, rigor, and strong organizational skills, which is why I believe my profile is an excellent match for the Research Associate position.  

Thank you for considering my application. I welcome the opportunity to discuss my qualifications further.

Sincerely,
